title: Man Met language - Wikipedia
text: Man Met, or Kemie, is a poorly classified Austroasiatic language spoken by about 1,000 people in Jinghong County, Xishuangbanna, China. It is classified as an Angkuic language by Paul Sidwell. It may be or Mangic according to Li Yunbing, or Palaungic.
